notes.title: Translations and More Achievents
notes.content: I have added 5 new achievements to gauge your progress, and I've machine translated Italian, Lat-American Spanish, Russian, French, and Portuguese.

notes.title: Fixed "Stand Up Guy" Ending
notes.content: I also found another bug while testing the ending to make sure it works. If you choose not to fight Bruce, you immediately lose health. I'll get that fixed here shortly, but for the meantime you can click "back" on the bottom of the screen or use your mouse wheel to back out of the screen without losing health if you weren't going to train with Bruce.

notes.title: Character Name translations working
notes.content: Just a quick patch after the translation upload because the character names were missing from the file. All fixed. Enjoy!

notes.title: Major Update - Chinese Simplified now available in game!
notes.content: All of the text and image-text has been translated to Chinese simplified in-game. If you already own the game, just go to the Preferences Screen and select the language change there! I will also be adding a handful of achievements to the game this week, so look out of a minor patch soon.

notes.title: Quick Sound Patch
notes.content:
Shower sound should properly end with scene instead of looping into following scenes. Using the auto-saves, you can backtrack to that point (A in the load map) and the finish of that scene will kill the shower sound. Saves you may have made following that scene may still have the persistent shower sound until the shower scene is repeated (even the non-sex option should work). 

I do listen to feedback, and I do want to make these games as enjoyable as I can. As the second owner of these games, my first goal was to reduce the many game-breaking bugs while updating them slightly to use the game engine's tools more effectively. I should have a patch coming next week that will address some of the repetition concerns and expand on the story more to fill those moments. Any input you can give me is appreciated, as I'm currently pre-production for Superspy Missions, the sequel to Superspy Steve.

notes.title: Now Live!
notes.content:
Superspy Steve is back and available on March 24th 2023! Experience the origin story of a man who will go on to become one of the greatest spy assets of all time. From these humble beginnings, catch all the lore of Steve in this adult clicker visual novel.

Please report any problems or bugs in the Community Hub and I will address them as I can.
